title: Special Executive Programme In Financial Reporting And Analysis
description: The course aims to equip learners with the knowledge and skills to interpret, analyze, and evaluate financial statements for strategic decision-making and business performance assessment.
longDescription: The Special Executive Programme in Financial Reporting and Analysis provides comprehensive training on financial statements, their components, and analytical tools. Participants will explore income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and gain proficiency in using financial ratios and International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) for effective financial analysis.
courseDetails: Understand the nature, structure, components, uses, and contained information of the Income Statement. Understand the nature, structure, components, uses, and contained information in a Balance Sheet. Understand the concept of cash flow in a business, its recording process, and the types of transactions for the cash flow. Understand the Classification of Cash Flows based on the types of financial activities. Understand the nature and structure of the cash flow Statement. Understand and utilize different Tools and techniques of financial statement analysis. Understand and utilize different Types of Ratios to analyze the financial health of an organization. Understand the International Financial Reporting Standards. This programme offers an in-depth understanding of financial reporting by focusing on key financial documents like income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements. Participants will learn to use financial statement analysis techniques, such as ratio analysis and trend identification, and apply International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) to assess organizational financial health. The programme emphasizes practical skills to interpret financial data for informed decision-making and strategy development. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Overview of Financial Statements: Statement of Income and Balance Sheet: Understanding Statement of Cash Flow and Non-financial Statements: Financial Statement Analysis Tools, Techniques, and Standards:
